info.title: Apps Webhooks
info.description: The Marketplace webhooks allow developers to receive events related to their app in the marketplace.

post.description:
Zoom triggers the **App Request Declined** event when an administrator declines a user's request to install an app.

## Prerequisites

* **Event Subscriptions** must be enabled for your [Marketplace app](https://marketplace.zoom.us/user/build) with the following configurations:
  * A valid **Event Notification Endpoint URL**.
  * The **App Request Declined** subscription enabled under the **Marketplace** event.

**[Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `marketplace_app:read:admin`

**[Granular Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `marketplace:read:app_request:admin`

A user or an account admin who installed your app can uninstall it at any time. The **App Deauthorization** event is triggered every time a user uninstalls or deauthorizes your app. ## Prerequisites * You have configured a valid deauthorization notification URL for your app. The field is located at the bottom of the **Information** tab of the [app configuration page](https://marketplace.zoom.us/develop/create). For more information, see [Deauthorization URLs](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/auth/deauthorization/) See Webhook verification for securing your webhook endpoint.

The **App Request Approval** event is triggered any time a user requests to install an app.

## Prerequisites

* **Event Subscriptions** must be enabled for your [Marketplace app](https://marketplace.zoom.us/user/build) with the following configurations:
  * A valid **Event Notification Endpoint URL**.
  * The **App Request Approval** subscription enabled under the **Marketplace** event.



**[Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `marketplace_app:read:admin`

**[Granular Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `marketplace:read:app_request:admin`

post.description:
Zoom triggers the **App Request Approved** event when an administrator approves a user's request to install an app.

## Prerequisites

* **Event Subscriptions** must be enabled for your [Marketplace app](https://marketplace.zoom.us/user/build) with the following configurations:
  * A valid **Event Notification Endpoint URL**.
  * The **App Request Approved** subscription enabled under the **Marketplace** event.

**[Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `marketplace_app:read:admin`

**[Granular Scopes](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/integrations/oauth-scopes-overview/):** `marketplace:read:app_request:admin`

event_ts.description: A timestamp at which the event occurred.

request_id.description: The unique ID for this app installation request.

app_id.description: The unique identifier for the app.

scope.description:
The scope of the admin's review action: 
* `all_users_on_account` — The admin declined the request for all users on the account. 
* `specific_users` — The admin declined the request for specific selected users.

reviewer_name.description: The display name of the administrator who declined the request.

reviewer_email.description: The email address of the administrator who declined the request.

reviewed_requests.description: A list of user requests that were declined. When `scope` is `all_users_on_account`, this might be absent. When `scope` is `specific_users`, this includes the declined users.

requester_name.description: The name of the user who requested to install the app.

requester_email.description: The email of the user who requested to install the app.

deauthorization_time.description: The date and time at which the user uninstalled the app.

signature.description: A unique ID for each instance of app deauthorization and uninstallation by the user.
